# Humae | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| One sentence | AI HR platform for small growth teams, with one staff catalogue, holiday, recruitment, OKR and performance intelligence. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competition Boundaries | Products are relatively new, with limited cases, ecological and business safety certificates; there is no evidence that Hong Kong remuneration, MPF or tax localization should not be used as a local remuneration system. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | The product is relatively new, with limited case studies, ecological and business safety certificates; there is no evidence that Hong Kong remuneration, MPF or tax localization should not be a local pay system. |
